# GlowTV

> GlowTV is a free, open-source IPTV player for iPhone, Android, Android TV, Google TV and Fire TV. It plays playlists you bring yourself — M3U/M3U8 links and files, or an Xtream Codes login — with an XMLTV TV guide, movies and series library, catch-up and favorites. GlowTV provides no channels, subscriptions or content. No account is needed; profiles and settings stay on your device. There is no Apple TV (tvOS) app yet.

- [GlowTV home](https://glowtv.app/): Free IPTV player for iPhone, Android and TV
